'''Tony Wroten Jr.''' (born April 13, 1993)<ref>{{cite web|title=Tony Wroten stats|url=http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/player/_/id/56838/tony-wroten|work=espn.go.com|accessdate=27 May 2012}}</ref>  is an American basketball player, most recently playing for the [[NCAA Division I]] [[Washington Huskies]].

==High School==
As a freshman at [[Garfield High School (Seattle, Washington)|Garfield High School]], Wroten averaged 20.8 points, 8.7 rebounds and 3.8 assists per game. He was named to the 2009 All-Washington State Class 4A first team, becoming the first ever freshman to be named to the first team. In his sophomore season, Wroten averaged 17.6 points, 6.4 rebounds and 4.9 assists per game. Wroten was forced to sit out his junior season after an [[Anterior cruciate ligament|ACL]] injury in a football game.<ref name=washprofile /> During his senior season, Wroten averaged 25.0 points, 7.5 rebounds and 4.1 assists per game.<ref>{{cite web|title=Tony Wroten Jr. Basketball Stats|url=http://www.maxpreps.com/athletes/b9GLnDAhKkC2rMSHOgDF9Q/basketball-winter-10-11/stats-tony-wroten-jr.htm|work=maxpreps.com}}</ref>

==College career==
In his freshman season at Washington, Wroten averaged 16.7 points, 5.0 rebounds and 3.6 assists per game. This was good enough for him to be named Pac-12 Freshman of the Year and to be named to the [[List of All-Pacific-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] first team. He was the first ever freshman from Washington to be named to the All-Pac-12 Team.<ref name=washprofile>{{cite web|title=Tony Wroten Profile|url=http://www.gohuskies.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/wroten_tony00.html|work=gohuskies.com|accessdate=27 May 2012}}</ref> On April 3, 2012 Wroten decided to enter his name in the [[2012 NBA Draft]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Washington's Tony Wroten declares for the NBA Draft|url=http://espn.go.com/nba/draft2012/story/_/id/7770913/washington-tony-wroten-declares-nba-draft|work=espn.go.com|accessdate=27 May 2012}}</ref> Wroten's Washington teammate [[Terrence Ross]] also decided to enter his name in the 2012 NBA Draft.<ref>{{cite web|title=Terrence Ross Declares for NBA Draft|url=http://www.gohuskies.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/040112aab.html|work=gohuskies.com|accessdate=27 May 2012}}</ref>

==Personal==
Tony's father, Tony, played football at the [[University of Washington]] and for the [[Tampa Bay Buccaneers]]. His mother, Shirley, ran track at Washington and at [[Arizona State University]]. Shirley still ranks top ten all time for Washington in the [[100 meter dash]], [[100 meter hurdles]], and [[4 × 100 metres relay]]. Tony's aunt, [[Joyce Walker]], was a two-time All-American basketball player at [[Louisiana State University]]. She was also the third women to ever play on the [[Harlem Globetrotters]]. Tony is also the cousin of [[Golden State Warriors]] point guard [[Nate Robinson]] and former [[Oregon State University]] basketball player, Jimmie Haywood.<ref name=washprofile />
